licensing.summary: Licensing terms have not been finalized. Applications must surface the status but must not block core features while enforcement is advisory.

raw.notes: TCGplayer is the raw-card market. Chinese cards have no automatic raw price source and stay manual.

graded.notes: Realized sales come from PkmnPrices eBay sold comps; eBay active listings are the fallback. Chinese slabs stay manual.

ai.notes: DeepSeek is consulted only when the on-device matcher/OCR result is below the app's confidence threshold.
